name: Vape
description: Guidelines for traveling with vape in your luggage.

carryOn.reason: Vapes, e-cigarettes, and disposable vapes are allowed in carry-on baggage only. The lithium batteries pose a cargo fire risk. Juice follows 3-1-1 rules.

checkedBag.reason: Vapes are strictly prohibited in checked baggage due to safety/fire rules.

tsa.pageTitle: Can I bring vape on a plane?

travelTips: Vapes, e-cigarettes, and disposable vapes are allowed in carry-on baggage only. The lithium batteries pose a cargo fire risk. Juice follows 3-1-1 rules.

faq.question: Is vape allowed in carry-on bags?
faq.answer: Vape is allowed in carry-on luggage. Vapes, e-cigarettes, and disposable vapes are allowed in carry-on baggage only. The lithium batteries pose a cargo fire risk. Juice follows 3-1-1 rules.

faq.question: Can you pack vape in checked baggage?
faq.answer: No, Vape is not allowed in checked bags. Vapes are strictly prohibited in checked baggage due to safety/fire rules.
